title: Computing Tools for Translation-Invariant Total Orders
summary: We introduce TITO_Explore, a software package for representing and computing with Translation-Invariant Total Orders (TITOs). We define a canonical window notation for TITOs and design and implement algorithms for several computational tasks involving them. The package normalizes the window notation of a given TITO into its canonical form, computes its inversion set, compares the weak order between two TITOs, and computes the join of two specified TITOs.
